2608.28252.title: Regime-Aware Portfolio Management via Retrieval-Augmented LLM-Guided Expert Switching
2608.28252.paper_summary: Financial markets are inherently non-stationary, making the effectiveness of individual portfolio-management strategies highly dependent on changing market conditions. This work proposes a retrieval-augmented expert-switching framework that dynamically selects portfolio management experts based on their historical performance under similar market situations. A dual-stream variational autoencoder represents asset-level and market-wide information, while a retrieval-based knowledge base stores historical situations and expert performance. During inference, an instruction-tuned LLM reasons over the retrieved evidence to identify the most appropriate expert rather than directly generating portfolio actions. We further establish a monotonicity property showing that adding a locally superior expert cannot degrade the switching mechanism's performance. Experiments across cryptocurrency, stock, and foreign-exchange markets show that the proposed selector achieves the highest cumulative return and Sharpe ratio among the evaluated selection strategies in all three markets. In the stock market, for example, cumulative return increases from 26% for the best fixed expert to 34%, while the Sharpe ratio improves from 0.74 to 0.96. Ablation results confirm the importance of both retrieval and LLM reasoning, while experiments with different expert-pool sizes demonstrate the value of complementary expertise. Overall, the findings support retrieval-grounded expert switching as an effective approach to adaptive portfolio management in non-stationary financial environments.
2608.28252.paper_summary_zh: 金融市場本質上是非平穩的，使得個別投資組合管理策略的有效性高度依賴於不斷變化的市場條件。這項工作提出了一個檢索增強的專家切換框架，根據專家在類似市場情況下的歷史表現動態選擇投資組合管理專家。一個雙流變分自編碼器表示資產級別和市場範圍的信息，而基於檢索的知識庫則存儲歷史情況和專家表現。在推理過程中，經過指令調整的LLM對檢索到的證據進行推理，以識別最合適的專家，而不是直接生成投資組合行動。我們進一步建立了一個單調性特性，顯示添加一個局部優越的專家不會降低切換機制的性能。在加密貨幣、股票和外匯市場的實驗中，所提出的選擇器在所有三個市場中實現了最高的累積回報和夏普比率。在股票市場中，例如，最佳固定專家的累積回報從26%增加到34%，而夏普比率從0.74改善到0.96。消融結果確認了檢索和LLM推理的雙重重要性，而不同專家池大小的實驗則展示了互補專業知識的價值。總體而言，這些發現支持基於檢索的專家切換作為在非平穩金融環境中進行自適應投資組合管理的有效方法。
